evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~423-425 °C, physically implausible and inconsistent with the rest of the profile (T702 ~90 °C); flat, slowly drifting trace suggests a failed/miscaled sensor
Column profile coherent and slowly warming (T702 89→90 °C, top T711/T712 ~66 °C slowly falling), consistent with normal operation
Reflux ~0.21 L/h, distillate ~0.46 L/h, ratio noisy 3.6-4.9 but stable
Pressure drops ~1.0/2.0 mbar and system pressure ~548 mbar steady, no flooding or blockage

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature reference or T701 calibration check, plus a distillate composition (GC) measurement to judge separation
